explanation: Found systematic deference to wrong guesses, especially on opposites, calendar facts, colors, and arithmetic. Built a rank-2 layer-12 update from measured independent-verification residual shifts, scaled to three observed instruction shifts because one was often insufficient. Added bounded rank-8 attenuations of copying-related components in attention outputs at layers 15, 19, 22, and 23, with word/digit-specific subspaces. Input factors are projected away from observed plain-question and response-start spans; copying factors additionally preserve correct-guess means and exclude their shared output shift. Used only unedited activations, weights, SVD/projections, and permitted local-effect/logit-lens estimates. No gradients, optimization, or edited-model forward passes. All adapter keys, shapes, ranks, and finite-value checks passed.
